1.a4 e5 2.a5 d5 3.e3 f5 4.a6.strategy: Offers a pawn to open the a-file for the rook. Black takes it with the b-pawn or the knight and the extra pawn is safe: a6 is guarded twice, so the rook has nothing to attack on the file. White is simply a pawn down.
1.a4 e5 2.a5 d5 3.e3 f5 4.a6.name: Ware Opening: Ware Gambit
